title: 第781章 圣皇第780章 蛊尊
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 听到第二祭司的叫嚣。
血渊魔尊仿佛听到了天大的笑话。
“死到临头，还敢大言不惭？”
他抬起手。
滔天的血煞之气，化作一只遮天蔽日的血色巨手，狠狠向着万蛊渊拍去。
“本尊倒要看看，是谁给你的底气！”
就在那血色巨手即将落下的刹那。
极轻极缓的振翅声，突兀地在这片天地间响起。
声音不大。
却让在场的神府大能同时心中一紧。
那只遮天蔽日的血色巨手，在声音出现的刹那，诡异的停滞了。
然后。
无声无息的开始消散。
血渊魔尊心中一颤。
脸上的狞笑凝住了。
其余人亦是神色大变，如临大敌。
一点紫金色的光芒，从万蛊渊底缓缓升起。
是那只有巴掌大小的人面八翼金蝉。
它静静的悬浮在半空中。
没有太多神异。
但它身上自然而然散发出的那种古老，沧桑的气息，却是让血渊魔尊等人无比心悸。
“这...这是什么鬼东西？”
血渊魔尊咽了口唾沫。
“通体紫金如琉璃...人面，八翼...”
林赤炎死死盯着那巴掌大小的紫金金蝉，声音干涩。
“这....这好像是古籍记载中的南荒初代大祭司本命蛊的人面六翼金蝉！”
此言一出。
十四位神府大能齐齐倒吸一口冷气。
南荒初代大祭司？
那可是几万年前的人物了。
他的本命蛊，竟能活到现在，那得有多强？
“可...可这个不是八翼吗？”
血渊魔尊脸色难看道。
心中抱着一丝侥幸。
林赤炎吞咽了一口口水。
声音发颤道：“人面金蝉，当实力达到了一定的程度，便会长出新的翅膀，而古籍记载中，数万年前南荒初代大祭司的本命蛊六翼金蝉，其实力，便达到了神府后期，而八翼....那最低得是神府大圆满。”
content_en:
Hear the cry of the second priest.
Blood Abyss Demon Lord seemed to have heard a big joke.
"How dare you talk so shamelessly when you are about to die?"
He raised his hand.
The monstrous blood evil energy turned into a giant blood-colored hand that covered the sky and the sun, and slapped Wan Gu Yuan fiercely.
"I want to see who gave you the confidence!"
At that moment when the giant bloody hand was about to fall.
“Buzz!!!”
The very light and slow sound of flapping wings suddenly sounded in the world.
Not loud.
But it made the powerful gods present feel tense in their hearts at the same time.
The giant bloody hand that covered the sky and the sun stopped strangely the moment the sound appeared.
Then.
Silently, it began to dissipate.
"What?!"
The Blood Abyss Demon Lord trembled in his heart.
The ferocious smile on his face froze.
The expressions of the rest of the people also changed drastically, as if they were facing a formidable enemy.
A bit of purple-gold light slowly rose from the bottom of the Ten Thousand Gu Abyss.
It was the golden cicada with a human face and eight wings that was only the size of a palm.
It floats quietly in mid-air.
Not much magic.
But the ancient and vicissitudes of atmosphere that it naturally exudes makes the Blood Abyss Demon Lord and others feel extremely palpitated.
"This...what the hell is this?"
The Blood Abyss Demon Lord swallowed.
"The whole body is purple gold like glass...a human face, eight wings..."
Lin Chiyan stared at the palm-sized purple golden cicada with a dry voice.
"This... this seems to be the human-faced, six-winged golden cicada recorded in ancient books as the birth Gu of the first generation high priest of the Southern Wilderness!"
As soon as this statement came out.
The fourteen great masters of the Divine Palace all took a breath of air.
The first high priest of the Southern Wilderness?
That was a person from tens of thousands of years ago.
His natal Gu can survive to this day, how strong must it be?
"But...but isn't this the Eight Wings?"
Blood Abyss Demon Lord said with an ugly expression.
There was a trace of luck in my heart.
Lin Chiyan swallowed.
The voice trembled: "When the human-faced golden cicada reaches a certain level of strength, it will grow new wings. According to ancient records, the strength of the six-winged golden cicada, the natal Gu of the first high priest of the Southern Wilderness tens of thousands of years ago, has reached the late stage of the Divine Palace, and the eight-winged...the lowest is the Divine Palace's Great Perfection."
